inicio_texto: DAM (Multiplatform Application Development) student and developer in training, currently interning building an ERP with Velneo.
sobreMi_subtitulo: More about my background and approach to development
sobreMi_texto: I'm Jordi, and one thing defines me above all: I don't settle for something just working — I want to understand why it works. That curiosity drives me to break down every problem before writing a single line of code. I'm well organized, communicate clearly, and adapt quickly to new teams and technologies — something I've already proven in real internship work, not just in theory.
sobrePro_texto: It all started with video games: I wanted to understand what was behind the worlds I enjoyed so much. That curiosity turned into a passion for logic, and that passion into the career I'm building now. I keep the same mindset: every project is an excuse to learn something new, and every line of code, a way to prove it.
habilidadesAptitudes_texto: Strong organization and planning skills, clear communication with the team, constant eagerness to learn, attention to detail, problem-solving, and quick adaptation to new work environments.
proyectos_subtitulo: A collection of applications, tools, and projects I've developed.
proyecto1_texto: End-of-course project in Java: a DragonQuest-style RPG with monsters, chests and a weapon system. Applies interfaces, inheritance and object-oriented programming.
proyecto2_texto: EA FC 26 player search tool built in JavaScript, with dynamic filtering by league and club, pagination, player detail view and favorites saved with localStorage.
proyecto_portfolio_desc: Modern portfolio built with Astro, TypeScript, multi-language support (ES, EN, CA), and Obsidian theme.
proyecto_liga_api: Football league management API built with Spring Boot and SQL.
